faq.q1: Can I start taxi work without my own car?
faq.a1: Yes. We provide fleet cars prepared for Uber, Bolt, and Free Now, so you can start working quickly without buying your own vehicle.
faq.q2: Is daily taxi car rental available?
faq.a2: Yes. Daily taxi car rental is available with clear terms, quick paperwork, and a fast path to getting on the road.
faq.a3: Yes. We offer lease-to-own programs: you keep working, make agreed payments, and gradually move toward owning the car.
faq.q4: Can I work with my own car?
faq.a4: Yes. We help check platform requirements, prepare the paperwork, and connect your car for work.
faq.q5: Do you offer official cooperation and help with documents?
faq.a5: Yes. We offer official cooperation formats and help with documents, legalization, platform onboarding, and taximeter setup.
faq.q6: Will I have manager support during work?
faq.a6: Yes. A manager helps with daily operational and organizational issues, including schedules, documents, platforms, maintenance, and ongoing work processes.
